items.note: Two poetry-writing experiments compare writing alone, editing an AI-generated poem, and co-creating with AI, with the creativity of the poems as the outcome; the abstract states neither N nor random assignment.

Participants see word lists labeled as coming from a human or from ChatGPT, at three creativity levels, and then complete the Divergent Association Task; the primes are 'purportedly' from ChatGPT, so the next stage should check whether any condition gives real generative-AI help.
Between-subjects brainstorming experiment (n = 75) compares people alone with human-GPT-3.5 dyads on fluency, flexibility, novelty, and value of ideas; assignment method not stated.
Conceptual framework on metacognitive adaptation under AI use with no data; the AAAI version lists seven capacities and the arXiv version (2606.05532) six.

Between-subjects experiment (N = 244) compares four human-AI interaction designs for a persona-creation task, scoring creativity, originality, and between-persona similarity; it has no no-AI arm, so the comparisons are AI configuration versus AI configuration.

Engineering students solve three TRIZ problems with and without LLM support, with design quality as an outcome alongside workload and perceived usefulness; the abstract gives no N or assignment method.

Meta-analysis of 56 experimental studies (9,643 participants) on AI-supported instruction and students' creative thinking, SMD = 0.54; AI is broader than generative AI (moderator 'stages of AI development').

Collocated groups do creative marketing tasks with generative AI or a web search engine, and external raters score the results in a second study; abstract taken from Semantic Scholar and gives no N or assignment method.

Within-subjects system study (N = 32) of Magic Easel compares a baseline with low- and high-similarity environment-grounded GenAI inspiration in drawing; divergent thinking rose versus baseline but whether it is scored on drawings is unclear, and N is below 50.
Observational analysis of NSF and NIH proposals (two R1 universities) and all public awards finds higher LLM involvement associated with lower semantic distinctiveness; same work as arXiv 2601.15485.
